Name: Turn the Dwarf into Sans
Author: Alansmelons
Description: To install this mod, go into (Program files x86/Steam/Steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Portraits) Copy the Dwarf.xnb file into here. You can either replace the already existing folder, but i would recommend backing up the original Dwarf file in case you want to use it again.
